summary: xAI (via SpaceXAI) announced that Gopuff's new AI shopping assistant, Go, is built on Grok's text, audio, and image models and is now live in the Gopuff app in the US.

mechanisms.reason: Grok models are deployed into a consumer shopping app used to generate carts, images, and voice interactions at scale, which would add inference calls, though no volume figures are given.
mechanisms.quote: Go is available now in the Gopuff app on iOS and Android, starting in the US with the UK to follow.

categories.reason: A delivery/shopping marketplace app is integrating an AI agent as a core feature of its consumer product.
categories.quote: Gopuff and SpaceXAI launched Go, an AI-powered shopping assistant built into the Gopuff app and powered by Grok text, audio, and image models.
